description: Multi use trail but primarily used for Mountain Biking. Singletrack, downhill only, black trail. Ridden North to South with steep descents and a few uphill punches. There are rocky bits and loose steep chutes with go-around detour options. Enjoy great views of Mount Currie. Dog friendly trail.
directions: Access from Mackenzie FSR at the North end of trail. (50.341950, -122.774680).
title: Overnight Sensation
